rule.description: User Account entitlement: do not match existing accounts
rule.comment: When using the User Account (notesAccount2) entitlement with the Identity Manager user application, Roles-Based Provisioning Module, or Role-Based Entitlements, accounts are created and deleted/disabled by granting or revoking the entitlement. Default policy does not match an existing account in Notes if the user is not entitled to an account in Notes.
